data.gender_notes: Marice is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Maria', which means 'resembling Mary'. In Christian tradition, Mary is the mother of Jesus and a symbol of grace and purity. The name Marice carries the meaning “Mary's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marice usually hope their child will grow to embody mary's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the grace and purity of Mary, inspiring faith and devotion.
data.etymology: Marice belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mary's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marice total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
